entities.name: Jean Philippe Eugène de Mérode
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Philippe-Eugène, Count de Mérode, 5th Marquess of Westerloo was a soldier and Feldmarschall of the Holy Roman Empire and a prominent member of the House of Merode. In Flemish and Dutch sources, he is known as Jan Filip van Merode-Westerloo.
